libdrm_nouveau (devkitPro's switch-libdrm_nouveau package), linked statically
into tssm.nro: the Nouveau GPU interface Mesa's driver uses on the Switch.

Under the MIT licence below. The copyright notices are in the source files
themselves; devkitPro's package recipe (source and patches) is under
switch/libdrm_nouveau in https://github.com/devkitPro/pacman-packages.
